## User or maintenance problem

Describe the player or maintainer situation and why the current behavior is a problem.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired result. Does legacy code already contain something similar?

## Acceptance criteria

How can the improvement be verified? Which settings, platforms, or existing data must remain compatible?

## Dependencies and related work

Is there a related roadmap item? Does this depend on authentication, isolation, runtime changes, another mod, or an API that needs investigation?
